The BNFC recommends that neonates may be given es- molol hydrochloride in an initial dose of 600 micrograms/kg by intravenous injection over 1 to 2 minutes; if necessary, this may be followed by an intravenous infusion at a dose of 300 to 900 micrograms/kg per minute.
